supersession_reason: The -v1 fixtures (frozen at b70ff58a) are superseded, not edited. The second independent review read them against their contract sources and found: op_mentions could only scan a 7-field outcome shape (the runner now scans the full result); W3 and L3 probed only `committed` after restart; the documented superset forget/dispute admission and the forged-complete-scope commit were unpinned; refused or parked proposals on a tombstoned id (docs/44 'reports 0 to any writer') were untested and falsified (review F-A); re-deletion of a deleted head/version (review F-C/F-D) and a former owner's dispute attempts (review F-E) were untested and falsified; R1's owner view cites docs/plan-776-777-772-exact-head-qualification.md, which v1 did not list; L2's 'content recoverable after a pruning' is implementation evidence, now labelled so. Every v1 case is carried forward unchanged in substance.
development_history: v1 was executed once with --allow-dirty before its freeze; its single corrected expectation (fixture 1, W5: a disputed head is withheld from the owner's own admission, docs/44) is carried into v2. v2 expectations were written from the contracts and the second review's findings before v2 was first executed. That first execution (on the working tree after the second review's remediation) failed four probes: W7c `a_del_refusal` was a runtime finding (a former owner's re-deletion or dispute of its own deleted generation answered `fact_not_found` once another scope held the live head and `already_deleted` otherwise, disclosing the re-creation; repaired at the governed delete/dispute boundary, pytest ReplayV2Findings), and three were expectation errors corrected to the owner-only control behaviour: W4b `k2_owner_recall` (a second remember onto an owner-visible head appends a version, both stay admitted), W5 `owner_candidates` (candidates carry the owner's superseded version; admission withholds the disputed head) and R6b `other_history` (the writer's own parked proposal precedes its commit in its own history). No expectation was changed to match a refusal string.
independence: Expected outcomes were written from the contract documents listed in contract_sources by the session that implemented the #786 repair, before this fixture was first executed by the runner. They are therefore preregistered but not independent of the implementer; an independent reviewer must read them against the contracts before any acceptance. A failing expectation is a finding, never a reason to edit this fixture; a corrected expectation requires a superseding fixture version with a recorded reason. No frozen holdout phrase or #644 fixture vocabulary is used.
stop_lines: no fixture edit after first execution; supersede with -v2 and record why
no expectation weakened to obtain PASS
no runtime change motivated by a replay outcome without a preregistered reproducer
a replay verdict is evidence, not successor acceptance; acceptance requires independent review
title: The owner of a deleted memory reads only its tombstone; every other observer reads nothing; views are stable under other scopes and restart

invariants.statement: The owner of a governed-deleted memory reads tombstoned, no current fact, no events, no rejected values, the version its deletion recorded, and no identifier or text of the deleted generation, live and after restart.
invariants.falsified_by: any identifier, text, event or rejected value, or a different version

invariants.statement: Another project reads the deleted memory byte-identically (ids and timestamps folded) to an id nobody wrote: history, a value probe, recall by logical reference, and historical recall, live and after restart.
invariants.falsified_by: any difference from the unknown-id result

invariants.statement: The owner's deleted view does not change when another project re-creates, corrects and deletes the same id.
invariants.falsified_by: any field of the owner's view changing

invariants.statement: A memory derived from a deleted fact is withheld from public recall while a live derivation keeps its provenance.
invariants.falsified_by: the derived-from-deleted memory or the deleted fact surfacing, or the live derivation lost

invariants.statement: A re-created generation's public history carries only its own events; another scope's refused attempt leaves no trace in it.
invariants.falsified_by: an event from the former generation or from a refused attempt

invariants.statement: No receipt on a governed-deleted id -- committed, refused or policy-parked, from any writer -- and no history of a new generation carries the former generation's version count.
invariants.falsified_by: a before_state, after_state, snapshot or history version continuing the former count
